note: autopilot starts or resumes a run of the autonomous pipeline and orchestrates it: the engine drives detached child sessions to a merge-ready PR and this session handles judgments and translates progress. Its near neighbours are the interactive pipeline commands the user drives in-session (task-start for intake, task-implement for implementation, task-deliver/pr-create for delivery) and read-only views (dashboard, task-summary). The distinction to measure is delegating the whole lifecycle to the unattended pipeline versus doing one phase in this session. 'Pipeline' in the CI sense is a trap. mock_rate encodes the IDEAL outcome; real deciders ignore it and measure the description.
